name: srud-agent
description: Repository-level shortcuts. Every script delegates to crates/desktop/package.json or to cargo, which stay the single source of truth for the commands they wrap.

scripts.format: cargo fmt && pnpm --dir crates/desktop run format
scripts.format:check: cargo fmt --check && pnpm --dir crates/desktop run format:check
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test:rust && pnpm run test:web
